record.bible_text: Now in the first<WH0259> year<WH08141> of Cyrus<WH03566> king<WH04428> of Persia<WH06539>, that the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> by the mouth<WH06310> of Jeremiah<WH03414> might be fulfilled<WH03615><WTH8800>, the LORD<WH03068> stirred up<WH05782><WTH8689> the spirit<WH07307> of Cyrus<WH03566> king<WH04428> of Persia<WH06539>, that he made a proclamation<WH05674><WTH8686><WH06963> throughout all his kingdom<WH04438>, and <FI>put it<Fi> also in writing<WH04385>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, <RF>made...: Heb. caused a voice to pass<Rf>
